raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the credits by assuming “songwriter(s)” meant only lyricists and that “composer” must be Brian Green, then wrongly conflated that Brian Green with actor Brian Austin Green. This unsupported role/identity leap led toward the incorrect father (George Green) instead of either recognizing Miley Cyrus as a credited composer (father: Billy Ray Cyrus) or properly disambiguating the producer/songwriter Brian Green.
